notice: Every vector in this file is a synthetic QA input written by the cc-k2-qa-01 task. None is a Scryfall fixture or authentic source data. No ID, name, URL, date, hash or count here describes a real card or a real upstream publication. Card-shaped JSON uses Scryfall card-object field names (https://scryfall.com/docs/api/cards) so parser tests can consume it; those field names were not re-verified by this task. Use these as test inputs only, never as application data or as the genuine K2 fixture.
